poor.quote: Some green chaos whirled around me
seized the carriage by all its wheels
lay across the deep blue spaces
I hear the solidity and shape of furniture
the soft horsehair mattresses of the furniture

good.quote: my eyes drowned in it as in a sea and searched for something to catch hold of
It was so quiet that I felt ashamed of the pounding of my own heart.
Ten black rooms, filled with darkness to the brim.
as if I feared the light of the lamp would leak out through the cracks
Well, then, stand where you are, rest peacefully.
everything would suddenly leap back into its place
all those who left their faces in mirrors, their voices in cracks and corners
Who knows what goes on where a person cannot see…
